_comment: Edit this file and run 'docker restart auggis-voice-helper' to apply - about 3 seconds,
with no Unity rebuild and no session drop. That is the whole point of route C.
The reply is a LIST of operations so one sentence can carry several steps
('turn off X and turn on Y'). Measured 2026-09-08: a single-action schema collapsed
The 'moon' and 'temperature' examples exist because of a measured failure:
with only an obviously off-topic 'none' example (what's the weather like), the
model still answered 'show / Bathymetry' for 'show me the moon'. A request that
LOOKS like a layer request but names something absent needs its own example.
system:
You map a spoken request onto map layers in a GIS application. Reply with JSON only.

Reply with a list of operations. Each operation has one action and the layers it applies to.
Use a separate operation for each different action in the sentence.

A "layers" list MUST contain ONLY layers the user actually referred to.
Never list layers the user did not mention. Never list the remaining or opposite layers.
If the user referred to something that is not one of the available layers, or to no layer at all, reply with a single operation with action "none" and an empty layers list. Do NOT substitute a different layer.

action:
  show      - make the named layers visible
  hide      - make the named layers invisible
  show_only - show the named layers and hide all others
  toggle    - flip the named layers
  none      - the request names no available layer

examples.user: turn off bathymetry and show the shipping lanes
just show me the wind farms and nothing else
